summary.text: Lauren Schoenfeld is a Republican candidate for the Wyoming State Senate, District 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She advanced from the August 18, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Lauren Schoenfeld graduated from Rock Springs High School and holds an associate degree from Central Wyoming College and a bachelor's degree from the University of Wyoming.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was raised in Farson and that her career has spanned private industry, nonprofit leadership, law enforcement and public service.

She said she has served as a Sweetwater County commissioner, is executive director of the Wyoming Innovation Partnership and a member of the Wyoming Workforce Development Council, and has served on the Wyoming Broadband Council.
Schoenfeld said in the survey that her priorities include defending the Second Amendment, protecting life, parental rights in education, local control and fiscal responsibility.
